objective: Add the shared accessible public division navigation to the verified gateway, Systems, and Studio shells.

criteria.promise: The three public division shells render one shared semantic navigation with truthful gateway, Systems, and Studio links.
The navigation is keyboard-native, has an accessible label, and exposes no private admin destination.
Focused navigation tests, route tests, and all foundation gates pass without changing product files outside this slice.

verification_gates.procedure: Read components/site-navigation.tsx and the three public layouts; run the focused navigation tests.
verification_gates.expected: Each public shell renders the same semantic navigation with links to /, /systems, and /studio.

verification_gates.procedure: Inspect the nav element and link elements and run focused tests for accessible label, hrefs, and absence of admin.
verification_gates.expected: The navigation uses native links, exposes an accessible name, has the three public destinations, and contains no /admin link.

verification_gates.procedure: From starter, run npm.cmd run lint; npm.cmd run typecheck; npm.cmd test; npm.cmd run build; npm.cmd run cf:build.
verification_gates.expected: All five commands exit 0, focused navigation tests pass, and the six direct routes remain buildable.

first_checkpoint.evidence: One shared navigation component, its use in all three public layouts, and focused link/accessibility tests.
